title: Precision N-species engineering in Pt–N4 via ring reconstruction towards efficient alkaline water electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01449B, Paper
Zhenyu Liu, Junyi Du, Jin Yang, Yuanyuan Yan, Yatong Wang, Meiling Wang, Tian Wang, Lixing Kang, Dingsheng Wang
By theoretical modeling and N-species engineering, we develop Con–Pt1@N[5]/[6]C catalysts with optimized N[5]/N[6] coordination. Internal N coordination and external Co coupling enables the achievement of 1.82 V@1 A cm−2 and 400 h stability in AEMWE.
